audience: site owners who collect contact and demo requests in Formcarry forms

useCases.title: Count the submissions of a form
useCases.text: List the forms to find the form id. Then count one form's submissions by day, week or country.

useCases.title: Read the unread submissions
useCases.text: List one form's submissions filtered by read state. Open one submission to see all its fields, country and uploaded files.

useCases.title: Find why a notification or webhook did not arrive
useCases.text: List the webhook deliveries with their status. Then check the notification and webhook status of the submissions.

useCases.title: Move a spam-looking submission out of the inbox
useCases.text: Mark one submission as spam. It leaves the inbox but is not deleted, and you can restore it later.

useCases.title: Search submissions across several forms
useCases.text: Search the most recently active forms, or the forms you name. Check whether the search is complete before you rely on it.
